title: superclaude.py installs an absent Claude Code, and a proof says so on every box
intention: superclaude.py installs Claude Code when it is absent and says so with --dry-run; a proof measures it on Windows and Linux.
why: Akien, 2026-11-11, quoted at cairn/devices/cc/superclaude:461: 'if claude is not installed, it should be'. Measured 2026-11-23: superclaude.py already carries the install branch and _install, written by 1941e93b25a3, but no proof drives it: test_superclaude_runs_from_python.py has no install tooth, and the only one is in test_superclaude_bare_box.py, which drives the bash that e179281f6eff retires.
traces_to: Akien's 2026-11-11 ruling; Law 3 and Law 8; outline 10.3.2.1.
how: One new proof drives main() through its seams with claude absent; superclaude.py changes only if a tooth reds on it.

clauses.claim: with claude absent, --dry-run prints that a real launch would install it from the url (the default https://claude.ai/install.sh, or CAIRN_CLAUDE_INSTALLER), calls no installer, and exits 0
a real launch with claude absent looks in ~/.local/bin first, then calls the installer with that url, and a claude found in ~/.local/bin is not installed over
an install after which claude is still not on PATH exits 127 with FAILED on stderr
_install fetches with curl or wget into sh where the launch tool says the box runs shell scripts, and runs the PowerShell installer where it does not

decisions.text: D1: one proof, one tooth per clause, red first, driving main() through its which/install/out/err seams with a scratch HOME; a mutant of superclaude.py with the install branch removed reds teeth 1-3, and a mutant with the fetcher choice swapped reds tooth 4.
D2: superclaude.py changes only if a tooth reds on it, and then only the install branch (lines 133-143, 376-392); a red there that needs more is a FIXME, not a widening.

measured.saw: superclaude.py:133-143 defines _install (curl or wget into sh, else powershell irm install.ps1) and :376-392 the absent-claude branch with the dry-run line and exit 127; test_superclaude_runs_from_python.py holds no tooth that names install.
measured.how: read superclaude.py and grep install over test_superclaude_runs_from_python.py on akiendell at origin/main ee12953c6
